in_sanskrit.name: Muthuraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mountains
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Muthuraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Muthu means 'Lord' or 'Mountain' in Sanskrit. Raj means 'Rule' or 'Reign'. Muthuraj is a name of Lord Murugan, the Hindu god of war, love, and fertility. He is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Muthuraj is a powerful deity who is believed to protect his devotees from evil and bestow them with strength, courage, and wisdom.

Muthuraj is a name of Lord Murugan, the Hindu god of war, love, and fertility. He is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Muthuraj is a powerful deity who is believed to protect his devotees from evil and bestow them with strength, courage, and wisdom.
